research_method.claude: Qualitative single-case study (Yin; Runeson & Höst) with hybrid (abductive) thematic analysis (Fereday & Muir-Cochrane); triangulation of 28 semi-structured interviews, 9 archival documents incl. DORA self-assessments 2021–2023, and a validation focus group (7 experts); member checking; Cohen's kappa 0.86
research_method.nlm: Qualitative single-case study with hybrid abductive thematic analysis; 28 semi-structured interviews, 9 archival documents (incl. longitudinal DORA assessments 2021–2023), expert focus group (7 participants)
research_method.value: Qualitative single-case study with hybrid (abductive) thematic analysis (Fereday & Muir-Cochrane), deductive codebooks (DevOps capability and metric taxonomies, ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207 processes) plus inductive coding; triangulation of 28 semi-structured interviews, 9 internal archival documents (incl. longitudinal DORA self-assessments 2021–2023) and a 90-minute expert focus group (7 participants)
research_method.note: Member checking and inter-rater kappa (0.86) reported only by Claude (not contradicted).

evidence.quote: To address this problem, this research conducts an in-depth single-case study to explore and explain the relational mechanisms (interaction) among DevOps capabilities, metrics, and lifecycle processes.
A hybrid (abductive) thematic analysis approach, guided by the analytical framework proposed by Fereday and Muir-Cochrane (2006), was employed to process the empirical interview data.
The study conducted 28 semi-structured interviews between June and September 2023 using an open-ended guide which is provided in full in Appendix A.
A 90-minute focus group was conducted with seven experts

The study focuses on a US-based private software company operating globally in the SaaS industry. Established in 2007 with over 1,200 employees, the organization provides enterprise digital experience platforms.
Key artifacts included longitudinal DORA self-assessment reports (2021-2023) capturing performance metrics (e.g., DF, MLT) and strategic presentations (D04-D06) outlining the transformation vision.

Internal DORA assessment results (2021-2023) Metric IT Performance Index (%) System Availability (%) Change Failure Rate (%) Staff Burnout (%) Lead Time Score (0-100) MTTR Score (0-100) Deployment Frequency Score (0-100)
Successful releases increased from 1,648 in 2021 to 2,084 in 2023, while critical defects identified in production decreased by over 70% (I01, I06, I20).
Analysis revealed a bidirectional relationship between 'Support for learning' (C02) and 'Team Happiness' (M21).
